steps.name: Force stop app
steps.action: adb shell am force-stop com.vasic.catalogizer.tv
steps.expected: App process terminated

steps.name: Launch from launcher
steps.action: Select Catalogizer from Android TV launcher
steps.expected: App launches and displays splash screen within 3 seconds

steps.name: Launch app
steps.action: Start Catalogizer from launcher
steps.expected: Splash screen appears with app logo and loading indicator

steps.name: Splash completes
steps.action: Wait for splash screen to dismiss
steps.expected: Splash transitions to home screen or login within 5 seconds

steps.name: Launch to home
steps.action: Start app and wait for home screen
steps.expected: Home screen loads

steps.name: Verify initial focus
steps.action: Check which UI element has focus
steps.expected: First focusable media item in top row has visible focus indicator

steps.name: Open app without session
steps.action: Clear app data and launch on TV
steps.expected: Login screen renders with server URL, username, password fields and login button

steps.name: Verify TV layout
steps.action: Check layout is optimized for TV (large text, readable from distance)
steps.expected: Fields and labels are large enough for 10-foot viewing experience

steps.name: Focus on username
steps.action: Navigate to username field with D-pad
steps.expected: Username field is focused with visible highlight

steps.name: Navigate to password
steps.action: Press D-pad down
steps.expected: Focus moves to password field

steps.name: Navigate to login button
steps.action: Press D-pad down
steps.expected: Focus moves to login button

steps.name: Navigate back up
steps.action: Press D-pad up twice
steps.expected: Focus returns to username field

steps.name: Enter credentials via remote
steps.action: Use D-pad and on-screen keyboard to enter admin/admin123
steps.expected: Credentials entered in fields

steps.name: Submit login
steps.action: Focus Login button and press Select/Enter
steps.expected: Loading indicator shows, then navigates to TV home screen

steps.name: Enter wrong credentials
steps.action: Type admin/wrongpassword and press Login
steps.expected: Error message displayed prominently on screen, readable from 10 feet

steps.name: Verify error dismissal
steps.action: Press any D-pad direction
steps.expected: Error message dismisses, focus returns to input fields

steps.name: Verify home screen
steps.action: Login and wait for home screen
steps.expected: Leanback-style home screen renders with horizontal rows of media content

steps.name: Check all rows visible
steps.action: Inspect home screen layout
steps.expected: Multiple category rows visible with media cards

steps.name: Check hero carousel
steps.action: Look for featured/hero carousel at top of home
steps.expected: Hero carousel shows featured media with large backdrop images

steps.name: Navigate carousel
steps.action: Press D-pad left and right on carousel
steps.expected: Carousel scrolls between featured items smoothly

steps.name: Select carousel item
steps.action: Press Select/Enter on focused carousel item
steps.expected: Navigates to media detail for that item

steps.name: Verify category rows
steps.action: Scroll down on home screen
steps.expected: Multiple rows visible: Recent, Movies, TV Shows, Music, etc.

steps.name: Scroll within row
steps.action: Press D-pad right to scroll through a row
steps.expected: Row scrolls horizontally to reveal more items

steps.name: Select item from row
steps.action: Press Select/Enter on focused item
steps.expected: Navigates to media detail screen

steps.name: Navigate between rows
steps.action: Press D-pad down to move between category rows
steps.expected: Focus moves to nearest item in next row

steps.name: Focus ring visible
steps.action: Check focus indicator on each item
steps.expected: Currently focused item has clearly visible border/highlight/scale effect

steps.name: Return to previous row
steps.action: Press D-pad up
steps.expected: Focus returns to previously focused item in upper row (focus memory)

steps.name: Navigate to top bar
steps.action: Press D-pad up from first row until top bar is focused
steps.expected: Top navigation bar receives focus

steps.name: Browse top bar items
steps.action: Press D-pad left/right through top bar
steps.expected: Focus moves between Home, Search, Settings icons

steps.name: Select item
steps.action: Press Select on Search
steps.expected: Navigates to search screen

steps.name: Find continue watching
steps.action: Look for continue watching row on home screen
steps.expected: Row shows previously started media with progress bars on cards

steps.name: Select item
steps.action: Focus and select a continue watching item
steps.expected: Media player opens and resumes from saved position

steps.name: Navigate to search
steps.action: Select search from top bar or press search button on remote
steps.expected: Search screen opens with on-screen keyboard or search input

steps.name: Activate voice search
steps.action: Press microphone button on remote or focus voice search icon
steps.expected: Voice search overlay or system voice input activates

steps.name: Speak query
steps.action: Say 'batman' into remote microphone
steps.expected: Voice input is transcribed and search executes

steps.name: Execute search
steps.action: Search for a known media title
steps.expected: Results grid/row appears with matching media items

steps.name: Navigate results
steps.action: Use D-pad to browse through results
steps.expected: Focus moves between result cards with visible focus indicator

steps.name: Select result
steps.action: Press Select on a result
steps.expected: Navigates to media detail

steps.name: Search nonexistent
steps.action: Search for 'zzzznonexistent99999'
steps.expected: Empty state message: 'No results found' displayed in large TV-friendly text

steps.name: Select media item
steps.action: Press Select on any media card from home screen
steps.expected: Detail screen opens with Leanback detail layout (backdrop, poster, info)

steps.name: Verify loading
steps.action: Check for loading state
steps.expected: Content loads without error, all sections rendered

steps.name: Check poster
steps.action: Inspect media detail screen imagery
steps.expected: Poster image displayed on left side

steps.name: Check backdrop
steps.action: Inspect background
steps.expected: Full-width backdrop image behind detail content

steps.name: Find play action
steps.action: Check action buttons on detail screen
steps.expected: Play button is the first/primary action, focused by default

steps.name: Press play
steps.action: Press Select/Enter on Play button
steps.expected: Media player launches and begins playback

steps.name: Check metadata
steps.action: Read metadata on detail screen
steps.expected: Title, year, duration, type, file size displayed in large readable text

steps.name: Check description
steps.action: Look for description or synopsis
steps.expected: Description text visible if available, truncated with 'more' option for long text

steps.name: Scroll to related
steps.action: D-pad down past action buttons
steps.expected: Related/similar media row appears below detail info

steps.name: Navigate related
steps.action: D-pad right through related items
steps.expected: Can browse related media cards

steps.name: Select related item
steps.action: Press Select on a related item
steps.expected: Navigates to that item's detail screen

steps.name: Start playback
steps.action: Select Play from media detail
steps.expected: Player activity opens, buffering indicator shown

steps.name: Verify playback
steps.action: Wait for buffering to complete
steps.expected: Video plays fullscreen with audio, no black screen

steps.name: Show transport controls
steps.action: Press Select/Enter during playback
steps.expected: Transport bar overlay appears with play/pause, seek bar, time

steps.name: Pause with D-pad
steps.action: Press Select/Enter on pause button or press Play/Pause key
steps.expected: Playback pauses

steps.name: Seek with D-pad
steps.action: Press D-pad left/right
steps.expected: Seek position moves backward/forward in increments

steps.name: Resume
steps.action: Press Select/Enter or Play key
steps.expected: Playback resumes from new position

steps.name: Play to midpoint
steps.action: Seek to approximately 50% of media duration
steps.expected: Player shows correct time position

steps.name: Exit player
steps.action: Press Back button
steps.expected: Player closes, returns to detail screen

steps.name: Check progress saved
steps.action: Look at media card on home screen
steps.expected: Progress bar visible on the media card showing ~50%

steps.name: Reopen partially watched
steps.action: Navigate to previously watched media and press Play
steps.expected: Resume prompt appears or playback starts from saved position

steps.name: Verify position
steps.action: Check current playback time
steps.expected: Playback is at or near the previously saved position

steps.name: Play media
steps.action: Start playback of any media item
steps.expected: Media is playing

steps.name: Press Back
steps.action: Press Back button on remote during playback
steps.expected: If controls are showing: controls dismiss. If controls are hidden: player exits to detail screen

steps.name: Verify return
steps.action: Check current screen
steps.expected: User is back on media detail screen, progress was saved

steps.name: Navigate to settings
steps.action: Select Settings from top bar or side menu
steps.expected: Settings screen opens with Leanback-style preference layout

steps.name: Navigate settings list
steps.action: Press D-pad up/down through settings options
steps.expected: Focus moves between setting items with visible indicator

steps.name: Select a setting
steps.action: Press Select/Enter on a setting
steps.expected: Setting expands or opens sub-screen for editing

steps.name: Go back
steps.action: Press Back
steps.expected: Returns to settings list with focus preserved

steps.name: Find server setting
steps.action: Navigate to server URL/address setting
steps.expected: Server address setting visible with current value

steps.name: Edit server
steps.action: Press Select to edit, type new URL via on-screen keyboard
steps.expected: On-screen keyboard appears, accepts input

steps.name: Save
steps.action: Confirm input
steps.expected: New server URL is saved and persisted

steps.name: Find theme setting
steps.action: Navigate to theme/appearance setting
steps.expected: Theme option visible

steps.name: Change theme
steps.action: Select alternate theme (Light/Dark)
steps.expected: App theme changes to reflect new selection

steps.name: Navigate entire app
steps.action: Use only D-pad (up/down/left/right/select/back) to navigate from home to search to detail to settings
steps.expected: Every screen and interactive element is reachable via D-pad alone

steps.name: No focus traps
steps.action: Attempt to navigate out of each section
steps.expected: No focus traps where D-pad cannot leave a section

steps.name: Check home screen focus
steps.action: Navigate home screen with D-pad
steps.expected: Focused item always has clearly visible highlight (border, scale, glow)

steps.name: Check detail screen focus
steps.action: Navigate detail screen action buttons
steps.expected: Focused button has visible focus state

steps.name: Check settings focus
steps.action: Navigate settings list
steps.expected: Focused setting has visible highlight

steps.name: Verify contrast
steps.action: Check focus indicator in both light and dark themes
steps.expected: Focus indicator meets accessibility contrast requirements

steps.name: Navigate deep
steps.action: Home -> Category -> Detail -> Player
steps.expected: User navigated 4 levels deep

steps.name: Press Back repeatedly
steps.action: Press Back button 4 times
steps.expected: Navigates back through: Player -> Detail -> Category -> Home

steps.name: Back from home
steps.action: Press Back on home screen
steps.expected: Exit confirmation dialog or app exits to TV launcher

challenges.name: TV Home Key Returns to Launcher

steps.name: Navigate into app
steps.action: Go to media detail screen within app
steps.expected: User is deep in app

steps.name: Press Home key
steps.action: Press Home button on remote
steps.expected: Returns to Android TV launcher, app goes to background

steps.name: Return to app
steps.action: Select Catalogizer from recents or launcher
steps.expected: App resumes on the same screen (media detail) where user left off

steps.name: Focus item in row
steps.action: Navigate to 3rd item in a category row
steps.expected: 3rd item is focused

steps.name: Enter and return
steps.action: Press Select to enter detail, then press Back
steps.expected: Returns to home screen

steps.name: Verify focus restored
steps.action: Check which item has focus
steps.expected: Focus is restored to the 3rd item in the same row where user left

steps.name: Launch from launcher
steps.action: Select Catalogizer from Android TV launcher
steps.expected: App launches, splash screen shows, transitions to login or home within 5 seconds

steps.name: Login via D-pad
steps.action: Navigate fields with D-pad, enter admin/admin123 using on-screen keyboard
steps.expected: Login succeeds, navigates to TV home screen with content rows

steps.name: Browse home content
steps.action: Use D-pad to navigate between category rows and items
steps.expected: Focus moves smoothly between rows and items, all content cards visible with focus indicators

steps.name: Navigate carousel
steps.action: Press D-pad left/right on hero carousel at top of home
steps.expected: Carousel scrolls between featured items with backdrop image transitions

challenges.name: User Flow: Select Item and View Detail

steps.name: Select item
steps.action: Focus a media card and press Select/Enter
steps.expected: Detail screen opens with Leanback layout showing poster, metadata, and action buttons

challenges.name: User Flow: Play Media and Return

steps.name: Play and exit
steps.action: Press Play on detail, watch for 5 seconds, press Back twice
steps.expected: Player starts, Back first shows/hides controls, second Back exits to detail, then Back to home

steps.name: Rapid D-pad presses
steps.action: Press D-pad up/down/left/right rapidly (10 presses per second) on home screen
steps.expected: Focus moves correctly without getting stuck, no ANR, no crash, UI remains responsive

steps.name: Hold D-pad right
steps.action: Press and hold D-pad right for 5 seconds on a long category row
steps.expected: Focus scrolls continuously through items, stops at end of row, no jank or missed frames

steps.name: Press diagonal
steps.action: Press D-pad up+right simultaneously on home screen grid
steps.expected: Focus moves in one direction (up or right, not diagonal), no crash or undefined behavior

steps.name: Tab through home
steps.action: Navigate through all interactive elements on home screen using D-pad
steps.expected: All media cards, navigation items, and action buttons are reachable in logical order

steps.name: Tab through detail
steps.action: Navigate through all interactive elements on detail screen using D-pad
steps.expected: Play, Favorite, Related items all reachable; focus order: actions row then related content row

steps.name: Tab through search
steps.action: Navigate through search input, keyboard, and results using D-pad
steps.expected: Keyboard, search results, and navigation are all reachable without focus traps

steps.name: Tab through settings
steps.action: Navigate through all settings options using D-pad
steps.expected: All setting items reachable, expandable settings work, focus returns correctly after editing

steps.name: Press Play/Pause
steps.action: Press Play/Pause button on remote during playback
steps.expected: Playback toggles between play and pause states

steps.name: Press Stop
steps.action: Press Stop button on remote during playback
steps.expected: Playback stops completely, returns to detail screen, progress saved

steps.name: Press Back
steps.action: Press Back button from various screens
steps.expected: Navigates to previous screen in back stack, from home shows exit dialog

steps.name: Press Home
steps.action: Press Home button from any screen in the app
steps.expected: Returns to Android TV launcher, app goes to background, resumes correctly when re-selected

steps.name: Press Menu
steps.action: Press Menu button on remote from home and detail screens
steps.expected: Context menu or options overlay appears with relevant actions for current screen

steps.name: Speak search query
steps.action: Press microphone button on remote, say 'batman movies'
steps.expected: Voice input transcribed to text, search executes, results for batman movies displayed

steps.name: Verify voice results
steps.action: Complete voice search and inspect results
steps.expected: Results displayed in TV-optimized grid, each card focusable, matching voice query content

steps.name: Check text sizes
steps.action: View all screens from 10 feet distance on a standard TV
steps.expected: All text is readable: titles >= 24sp, body >= 18sp, labels >= 16sp, no tiny text anywhere

steps.name: Check button sizes
steps.action: Inspect all interactive elements for minimum touch/focus target size
steps.expected: All buttons and focusable elements are at least 48dp in both dimensions, clear focus highlight

steps.name: Check contrast ratios
steps.action: Inspect text and background colors on all screens
steps.expected: Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text) in both light and dark themes

steps.name: Let device idle
steps.action: Leave app idle until Android TV screensaver activates
steps.expected: Screensaver activates normally, app state preserved in background

steps.name: Dismiss screensaver
steps.action: Press any button on remote to dismiss screensaver
steps.expected: App resumes on the exact screen where user left off, no re-login, data intact, WebSocket reconnects if needed
